note: Frozen area and sub-area list from the PVCompass build specification (4 Oct 2026), section 5. Codes must not change once any mapping exists.

areas.name: PV system and quality management
areas.description: The PSMF, QPPV and local responsible persons, SOPs, training and governance of the PV system.

sub_areas.name: PSMF
sub_areas.description: The PV system master file, its annexes, logbook and location.

sub_areas.name: QPPV and local responsible persons
sub_areas.description: QPPV, deputy and country-level PV contacts, their availability and oversight.

sub_areas.name: SOPs and document control
sub_areas.description: Written procedures covering every PV process, kept under version control.

sub_areas.name: Training
sub_areas.description: Role-based PV training and awareness training outside the PV function.

sub_areas.name: Governance and oversight
sub_areas.description: Management review, PV committees and escalation of safety issues.

areas.name: ICSR management
areas.description: Individual case safety reports from intake through assessment, coding, submission and follow-up.

sub_areas.name: Intake from all sources
sub_areas.description: Spontaneous, solicited, literature, partner, social media and other sources of adverse event data.

sub_areas.name: Validity, seriousness, expectedness, causality
sub_areas.description: Case validity criteria and medical assessment of each case.

sub_areas.name: Coding and data quality
sub_areas.description: MedDRA and WHODrug coding, narrative quality and case QC.

sub_areas.name: Expedited reporting and submission
sub_areas.description: Timely electronic submission of expedited reports to each authority.

sub_areas.name: Follow-up
sub_areas.description: Obtaining missing information for serious and important cases.

sub_areas.name: Duplicates
sub_areas.description: Detecting and managing duplicate case reports.

areas.name: Literature monitoring
areas.description: Screening of global and local scientific literature for adverse reactions and safety information.

sub_areas.name: Global search
sub_areas.description: Searches of major literature databases at the required frequency.

sub_areas.name: Local literature
sub_areas.description: Local journals in the markets where products are authorised.

sub_areas.name: Search strategy and review records
sub_areas.description: Documented search strings, results, reviewer decisions and day-zero dates.

areas.name: Signal management
areas.description: Detection, validation, prioritisation, assessment and communication of safety signals.

sub_areas.name: Detection
sub_areas.description: Routine review of all relevant data sources for new or changed risks.

sub_areas.name: Validation and prioritisation
sub_areas.description: Deciding whether a signal is valid and how urgently to assess it.

sub_areas.name: Assessment
sub_areas.description: Evaluation of validated signals and the decision on action.

sub_areas.name: Tracking and notification
sub_areas.description: Signal tracking records and notification of authorities and partners.

areas.name: Aggregate reports
areas.description: PSURs/PBRERs, PADERs/PAERs and DSURs, their content and on-time submission.

sub_areas.name: PSUR/PBRER
sub_areas.description: Periodic benefit-risk evaluation reports for authorised products.

sub_areas.name: PADER/PAER
sub_areas.description: US periodic adverse drug experience reports.

sub_areas.name: DSUR
sub_areas.description: Development safety update reports for investigational products.

sub_areas.name: Scheduling and submission compliance
sub_areas.description: Tracking of data lock points, due dates and submission evidence.

areas.name: Risk management
areas.description: Risk management plans, REMS, additional risk minimisation and its effectiveness.

sub_areas.name: RMP
sub_areas.description: EU-format and other risk management plans and their updates.

sub_areas.name: REMS
sub_areas.description: US risk evaluation and mitigation strategies and assessments.

sub_areas.name: aRMM implementation
sub_areas.description: Additional risk minimisation measures delivered in each market.

sub_areas.name: Effectiveness evaluation
sub_areas.description: Measuring whether risk minimisation is working.

areas.name: Reference safety information
areas.description: Company core safety information, labelling updates and the reference safety information for trials.

sub_areas.name: CCDS/RSI maintenance
sub_areas.description: Governance of the company core data sheet and core safety information.

sub_areas.name: Label update timeliness
sub_areas.description: Timely implementation of safety changes in local labels.

sub_areas.name: IB RSI
sub_areas.description: Reference safety information in investigator's brochures.

areas.name: Partner and vendor management
areas.description: Safety data exchange agreements, vendor oversight, reconciliation and audits of partners and vendors.

sub_areas.name: SDEAs
sub_areas.description: Safety data exchange agreements with licensing and distribution partners.

sub_areas.name: Vendor contracts and oversight
sub_areas.description: Contracts and KPI oversight of service providers performing PV activities.

sub_areas.name: Case reconciliation
sub_areas.description: Reconciliation of safety data exchanged with partners and vendors.

sub_areas.name: Partner and vendor audits
sub_areas.description: Risk-based audits of partners and vendors.

areas.name: Clinical trial safety
areas.description: Safety in clinical development: SAEs, SUSARs, IND safety reports, unblinding and DSMBs.

sub_areas.name: SAE handling
sub_areas.description: Collection and processing of serious adverse events from trials.

sub_areas.name: SUSAR and IND safety reporting
sub_areas.description: Expedited reporting from clinical trials to authorities, ethics committees and investigators.

sub_areas.name: Unblinding
sub_areas.description: Unblinding of cases for expedited reporting while protecting trial integrity.

sub_areas.name: DSMB and IB/protocol alignment
sub_areas.description: Data monitoring committees and consistency of safety content across trial documents.

areas.name: Safety data and systems
areas.description: The safety database, E2B gateway, data migration, validation and access control.

sub_areas.name: Safety database
sub_areas.description: The system of record for adverse event cases.

sub_areas.name: E2B gateway
sub_areas.description: Electronic transmission of ICSRs to authorities and partners.

sub_areas.name: Data migration
sub_areas.description: Moving case data between systems without loss or change.

sub_areas.name: System validation
sub_areas.description: Validation and change control of computerised PV systems.

sub_areas.name: Access control
sub_areas.description: User access, audit trails and business continuity.

areas.name: Audit, CAPA and compliance
areas.description: The PV audit programme, CAPAs and deviations, compliance KPIs and inspection management.

sub_areas.name: Audit programme
sub_areas.description: Risk-based PV audit strategy and plan.

sub_areas.name: CAPA and deviations
sub_areas.description: Recording, root-cause analysis and follow-through of corrective actions.

sub_areas.name: Compliance KPIs
sub_areas.description: Measurement and review of PV compliance metrics.

sub_areas.name: Inspection management
sub_areas.description: Readiness, hosting and response for regulatory inspections.

areas.name: Cross-functional interfaces
areas.description: How safety information reaches PV from medical information, quality, regulatory affairs and commercial programmes.

sub_areas.name: Medical information
sub_areas.description: Adverse events received through medical information enquiries.

sub_areas.name: Product quality and complaints
sub_areas.description: Exchange between product complaints and PV.

sub_areas.name: Regulatory affairs
sub_areas.description: Regulatory submissions, commitments and correspondence with safety content.

sub_areas.name: Commercial programmes
sub_areas.description: Patient support programmes, market research and digital channels.
